subject: Re: Migration incentive & slab pricing proposal for StellarApps
messages:
From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@stellarapps.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>
Cc: Anita Mehra <anita@stellarapps.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2026 22:12:00 -0400
Subject: Request: migration incentive & slab pricing for StellarApps

Hey Logan,

Thanks for the demo last week. StellarApps is evaluating a move off our current provider (we're comparing per-token economics vs OpenAI/Anthropic + their hosted endpoints). To make the case internally I need a clear, comparable offer:

- A per-token slab or tier schedule for Hosted API (gpt-style text gen + embeddings) with estimated $/1k tokens at our volumes
- Any short-term migration credits or one-time rebates you can offer to offset switching costs
- A commitment tier (12mo / 24mo) that gets us to price parity with our current provider — or an explicit "migration incentive" threshold

We expect ~1.2B tokens/mo at peak (70% gen, 30% embeddings), currently on a month-to-month plan. Procurement will want the numbers side-by-side. Can you share something concrete this week?

Thanks,
Sanjay
Director of ML Platforms
StellarApps

---
From: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@stellarapps.com>
Cc: Anita Mehra <anita@stellarapps.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 09:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Request: migration incentive & slab pricing for StellarApps

Hi Sanjay — great to hear from you and thanks for the clear ask. We can absolutely put together a side-by-side that maps to your usage and propose a migration package. High level (for discussion):

- Usage-based slabs: 0-200M, 200M-800M, 800M+ tokens/mo with progressive per-token rates (gen vs embeddings separate).
- 12-month and 24-month commit ladders with effective blended $/1k tokens.
- One-time migration incentive: credits applied to first 3 invoices (or a volume-based rebate after month 1) — can be structured as upfront credits or usage rebates tied to onboarding milestones.

To be precise I need: a 3-month token burn sample (gen vs embeddings split) and any SLO/latency requirements that affect model selection (e.g., if you must use low-latency variants we may have different pricing). Can you attach your usage CSV?

I'll loop in our pricing lead for approval for any one-off credit. If you're comfortable, I'll draft a proposal (PDF) and a DocuSign-ready term sheet.

Warmly,
Logan Wright
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 13:48:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: migration incentive & slab pricing for StellarApps

Logan — thanks for the heads-up. For StellarApps scale, here's what I'm comfortable approving without exec escalation:

- Slab breakpoints: 0-250M, 250M-1B, 1B+. Use these as defaults; we can tweak for edge cases.
- Baseline list rates (example): gen $0.0032 /1k tokens (0-250M), $0.0024 (250M-1B), $0.0016 (1B+); embeddings ~40% of gen rate.
- Migration incentive: up to $150k in credits applied across first 90 days for a 12mo commit; up to $300k for a 24mo commit — conditioned on signing within 30 days and a minimum monthly commit.
- If they need parity to OpenAI/Anthropic's effective price we can do an additional time-limited rebate (retroactive credits) but require documented usage and a HubSpot deal milestone.

If you intend to offer more than the above, loop in Sales Ops / Revenue Ops.

Ben
Head of Sales | Redwood Inference

Logan — attaching our 3-month burn export (see Stellar-MAAP-Usage-Report.csv). Key clarifications:

- 70% of tokens are gen, 30% embeddings on average.
- Peak monthly spike historically hits ~1.1–1.4B tokens for marketing campaigns.
- Latency: 95th percentile must be <350ms for per-request gen (our product UX requirement).

Procurement note: we prefer credits vs rebate so the cost impact is immediate in Q4. Also, if you can match the effective $/1k tokens we're getting today (I'll share a redacted invoice if needed), we'll fast-track legal.

Thanks — attaching CSV.

Sanjay

From: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@stellarapps.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 23 Sep 2026 14:00:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Request: migration incentive & slab pricing for StellarApps

Sanjay — thanks for the file and the latency note; that clarifies model selection. I attached a one-page proposal (Redwood-HostedAPI-Proposal-Stellar-v2.pdf) but calling out the highlights inline:

- Proposed slabs (blended effective): 0-250M @ $0.0030/1k (gen), 250M-1B @ $0.0022/1k, 1B+ @ $0.00145/1k; embeddings at 0.4x gen.
- 12-month commit: guaranteed minimum monthly commit that drops effective blended price by ~12% vs list.
- 24-month commit: additional 8% off top of 12mo.
- Migration package (time-limited if signed within 30 days): $200k in upfront credits applied to first 90 days + 60 days of free onboarding support (technical onboarding hours).
- Alternative structure: if you prefer direct parity to your current provider's effective $/1k, we can add a retroactive rebate equal to the difference for the first 3 months post-switch (requires invoice proof).

I've created a DocuSign-ready term sheet and HubSpot deal entry. If Procurement wants the credits on contract vs invoice credits we can do that too — flexible.

If this looks reasonable, I'll send the DocuSign and route for signature; Ben has pre-approved up to $150k in credits but I requested additional one-time migration credits from him which would allow $200k total for a 12mo.

Best,
Logan

[attachment: Redwood-HostedAPI-Proposal-Stellar-v2.pdf]
